h1.text: This is Rosa. She runs a bakery, and a customer owes her twenty-eight hundred dollars.

h2.text: But Rosa owes the mill three thousand. The mill owes the trucking company. And the trucking company? It owes Rosa.

h3.text: Everyone is owed. Nobody can pay. So everyone waits.

h4.text: Fifty-six percent of American small businesses are owed money right now. About seventeen and a half thousand dollars each.

h5.text: But debts that run in a circle can simply cancel. No money has to move.

h6.text: On our Main Street, twenty-eight thousand dollars of invoices settled with just twenty-two hundred dollars of PayPal payments.
